name: E-Cell LIET
institution: Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology (LIET)
intro: The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) of Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology (LIET) is a student-driven initiative dedicated to fostering entrepreneurship, innovation and leadership among students.
purpose: E-Cell provides a platform where students can transform ideas into meaningful solutions through workshops, competitions, expert sessions, networking opportunities and hands-on activities.
vision: To build an environment where creativity, innovation and entrepreneurial thinking can grow among students.
mission: To encourage students to explore entrepreneurship, develop problem-solving skills and gain practical exposure to the startup ecosystem through learning, collaboration and action.
nec: E-Cell LIET also participates in the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) ecosystem associated with E-Cell, IIT Bombay.
